pages.title: Example site
pages.description: One page assembled from section templates.

props.heading: A page written as data
props.lead: The builder reads this file and returns HTML. No template language, no build server.

props.heading: What is here
items: Thirteen section templates, each one a plain function.
A builder that rejects an unknown section before it renders anything.
A publish step that signs every request to the hosting panel.

items.title: Builder
items.text: Page JSON in, HTML files out.

items.title: Preview
items.text: A local server over the built output.

items.title: Publish
items.text: Signed requests to the hosting API.
The page is data and the tests run in a second.
items.author: A maintainer

items.q: Where do the hosting keys live?
items.a: In raips.config.json, which stays out of git.

items.q: Can I publish without a credential?
items.a: The fake driver accepts a publish and keeps it on disk.

props.heading: Ready to publish
props.text: Fill the sample config and run the publish verb.

props.heading: About
paragraphs: Every section on this page comes from a function in src/sections.
The builder renders the same way for one page and for fifty.
